purchases.title: Fzero: The Artist Creates First
purchases.summary: Fzero is a designer, illustrator, node runner, and co-founder of Ninefold, the studio he runs with Ivy Lumi. Their line is "stories that make you build." He started by copying manga as a kid. He studied economics, finance, and marketing, then opened stores and ran the floor for big fashion brands. The work looked like a career. It did not feel like one. On December 25, still under 30 and home with his family, he had a stroke. He already knew Bitcoin. He had been stacking sats for years. The scare settled the question. purchases.title: Joe Martin: It's All About the Song
purchases.summary:
Joe Martin is a singer-songwriter and a 21st century troubadour. The song comes first. He grew up in the UK, learned piano as a child, picked up his father's guitar as a teenager, and has spent a decade writing Americana and country, with trips to Nashville along the way. He is based on the Isle of Man. He is fully independent. He sells merch for sats.
In this episode, Bitcoin For The Arts founder Dion Wilson talks with Joe about Alone in Valentine, the album he made on purpose without AI. He recorded it in Nashville with Cal Campbell, son of Glen Campbell, and Cornelius Webb, son of Jimmy Web
